svg.text: CORE AI EVALUATION METRICS: TTFT, TPOT/ITL, E2EL, DUAL-SLA GOODPUT & $/1M TOKENS
Dual-SLA Goodput Pareto Tuning Delivers 5.16x Higher Valid Throughput & -80.5% Effective $/1M
8x H200 Llama-3.3-70B-FP8: Tier 1 Raw-TPS Max (2,650 Raw TPS -> 410 Goodput TPS) vs. Tier 4 Pareto Knee (2,115 Goodput TPS)
⛔ Tier 1 & 2 Traps: The "High Raw TPS" & "P50 TPOT" Illusions
1. Trap A: Optimizing Raw TPS Instead of Dual-SLA `Goodput`:
• Pushing batch size to `B=256` hits `2,650 raw tok/s/GPU`, but
`P99 TTFT` explodes to `4.85s` and `P99 ITL` hits `92.4ms`!
2. Trap B: Confusing Request-Average `TPOT` with Step `P99 ITL`:
• A 400ms mid-stream Prefill stall averaged over 200 tokens looks
like only `+2ms` mean TPOT, yet freezes real-time voice TTS!
3. Trap C: Ignoring Reasoning `<think>` Impact on `E2EL`:
• `E2EL = TTFT + (N_out - 1) × TPOT` scales linearly with `N_out`
Tier 1 Raw-TPS Benchmark Failure Impact:
• Raw TPS: 2,650 tok/s/GPU | Valid Goodput: Only 410 tok/s/GPU!
• P99 TTFT: 4,850ms | P99 ITL: 92.4ms (84.5% SLA breach rate)
• Effective Cost per 1M Goodput Tokens: $2.41 / 1M
🏆 Tier 4: Dual-SLA Goodput & 5-Scenario Golden Benchmarks
1. Exact E2EL & Dual-SLA Goodput Equations:
• `E2EL = TTFT + (N_out - 1) × TPOT`
• `Goodput = TPS × P(TTFT <= SLA_TTFT ∧ P99_ITL <= SLA_TPOT)`
2. 5-Scenario Golden SLA Targets (P95 TTFT / P99 ITL):
• Voice Agent: `<=250ms / <=18ms` | IDE FIM: `<=150ms / <=10ms`
• RAG Chat: `<=800ms / <=25ms` | Reasoning: `<=1.5s / <=15ms`
3. Pareto-Knee Concurrency Cap (`max_num_seqs` + PD Split):
• Operates at the exact knee before P99 ITL crosses `25ms`
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• SLA-Compliant Goodput: 2,115 tok/s/GPU (5.16x vs. Tier 1!)
• Effective Cost per 1M Goodput Tokens: $0.47 / 1M (-80.5%)
